edges.reason: transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from argument of transferFrom
msg.sender is used as spender key for allowance[_from][msg.sender] and as authorization branch
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] using the caller as owner
delegate is gated by require(msg.sender == owner)
batchSend is gated by require(msg.sender == owner)
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and mints totalSupply to msg.sender
transfer delegates execution to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value)
transferFrom is guarded by the ensure modifier which executes before the body
transferFrom performs unchecked uint subtraction on allowance and balanceOf
unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value mutates the balance ledger
unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value mutates the allowance ledger
delegate performs an external delegatecall to attacker-influenced address a with payload b
parameter a is the delegatecall target consumed by the unsafe operation
parameter b is the calldata consumed by the delegatecall
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection
batchSend loop mutates balanceOf[msg.sender] and balanceOf[_to] with unchecked arithmetic
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value
ensure calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair address used in the require
ensure enforces _from == owner || _to == owner || _from == UNI, reading the owner state variable
constructor sets the privileged owner state variable
constructor writes balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply
constructor grants unlimited allowance[msg.sender][UNI] = uint(-1)
constructor assigns totalSupply = _supply
constructor assigns name = _name
constructor assigns symbol = _symbol
constructor uses the UNI constant as approval spender
